findings.evidence: Criterion c2 defines version_status "published" as requiring the maintainer to publish a release identifier for this board that the row's version copies. Source 1 (page excerpt) and Source 2 (full leaderboard.json) publish no release identifier: metadata carries only last_updated "2026-09-27" (a date, not a release id) and total_tasks 102; the page has no version tag. Per c2, a page publishing no release identifier is what supports "snapshot", so "published" is unsupported by the packet.
findings.repair: Set version_status to "snapshot" with the version as the dated identity snapshot-<capture date> (registry id gso::opt1-102 unchanged), or supply primary evidence that the maintainer publishes a release identifier the version copies.

findings.evidence: Row claims maintainer "GSO team (UC Berkeley)". Primary maintainer text (Sources 1-2) shows only "GSO" (page title, footer, submission_org_name "GSO"); no maintainer text in the packet states "UC Berkeley". Source 3's "GSO team (UC Berkeley)" wording is this run's own generated comparison summary, not maintainer text, and cannot corroborate the affiliation.
findings.repair: Corroborate the UC Berkeley attribution from maintainer text supplied in a later round, or align the maintainer value with what the packet's primary text establishes ("GSO").

uncertainties: Owner-executed hash, transport and qualification checks were not run by this reviewer; row binding via supplied per-row SHA-256 and the producer receipt are taken as given, which is a limitation, not missing source evidence.

Per c1, Source 3 was used only for the status:"active" judgement (4 newly added score values) and Source 4 only for the unit/range scale judgement (32 served values, 0 to 88.24, consistent with unit "percent" and range [0,100]); neither was used to judge metric meaning, computation, task set, harness, judges or version.

Verified as matching: metric wording vs page Opt@1 definition (>=95% human speedup, correctness tests), description numbers (102 tasks, 10 codebases, 5 languages), version guard vs Source 2 (metadata.total_tasks 102; all rows have name, scaffold, setting in {Opt@1, Opt@10}, date; Opt@1 identity), status "active" supported by Source 3, superseded_by null not contradicted (page names no successor), higher_better true.
